001: Carlos, my head has been hurting a lot since this morning.
Really? Have you taken anything for the pain?
Not yet, I wanted to ask you what you recommend.
I would take a paracetamol and rest for a while.
Okay, thanks. I'll go to the pharmacy to buy it.
You'd better go soon and not let it drag on.
002: Good morning, I'm here because I've had a fever since last night.
How long have you had that fever exactly?
It started yesterday afternoon, around six.
And have you had a cough or any other symptoms?
Yes, I also have a bit of a dry cough.
I'm going to prescribe you something to bring down the fever.
003: Marta, my throat hurts a lot when I swallow.
That looks bad! Has it been hurting for long?
Since yesterday, and today I woke up feeling worse.
You should drink plenty of water and gargle with salt.
Do you think that will make it go away?
If you're still the same tomorrow, you'll have to go to the doctor.
004: I twisted my ankle playing soccer.
Wow! Can you put your foot on the ground?
I barely can, it hurts quite a bit when I move it.
You should put ice on it right now for the swelling.
And do you think I need to go to the emergency room?
If you can't put weight on it, you'd better get it checked out.
005: Lately I've been feeling very tired and without energy.
Are you sleeping well at night?
I sleep more or less, but I wake up very tired.
You might be low on iron or some vitamin.
Do you recommend I get a blood test?
Yes, it would be good for the doctor to order one for you.
006: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest pharmacy is?
Yes, there's one two streets from here, next to the supermarket.
It's just that I need to buy something for my allergy.
Are you allergic to pollen, if you don't mind me asking?
Yes, especially at this time of year.
They'll sell you something over the counter, but if not, go to the doctor.
007: Diego, my stomach hurts after eating.
What did you eat today? Maybe something didn't agree with you.
I had a salad, but the dressing was very strong.
That happens to me when I eat very spicy food.
What do you usually do to relieve it?
I drink some chamomile tea and wait a while.
008: I've been sneezing all day, I can't stop.
Do you have allergies or do you think it's a cold?
I don't know, but my eyes are also very itchy.
That sounds more like an allergy than a cold.
Yes, but ask at the pharmacy first just in case.
009: I cut my finger with a knife and it won't stop bleeding.
Oh, careful! Is the cut very deep?
Not very, but it's bleeding quite a bit.
Wash it with soap and water and press on it with a gauze pad.
Should I put a band-aid on it after?
Yes, and if you see it's still bleeding, go to the emergency room.
010: Lately my back hurts from sitting for long periods of time.
Do you work many hours in front of the computer?
Yes, I spend almost the whole day sitting at the office.
You should get up and stretch every hour.
And do you recommend any specific exercise?
Stretching your lower back and walking a bit will do you good.
